Company description:
Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.
Job description:Data Engineer Let’s accelerate the transformation. Together. We are looking for a Data Engineer who wants to help shape the next chapter of our digital and AI journey within the Tools division. This is a role for someone who enjoys building from scratch, working close to real business challenges, and enabling AI solutions at scale in a global industrial environment.
  
 Join our team
 At Epiroc Tools division, we are building a new Data & AI capability to accelerate the adoption of AI across our global operations, products, and services. As part of the Digital Innovation team, you will be at the center of this transformation, where we develop scalable AI products supporting the entire division. We are now expanding our team with dedicated Data Engineering capabilities to strengthen the foundation for our AI and analytics solutions. You will work closely with data scientists, product leads, and business stakeholders to build robust, scalable data pipelines that power AI-driven products end-to-end.
  
 Your missionAs a Data Engineer, your mission is to build and scale the data foundation that enables modern AI products. You will play a key role in designing and implementing data pipelines, ensuring data quality, and enabling advanced analytics and machine learning across the organization.
 You will:•    Design, build, and optimize data pipelines for large-scale, cloud-based environments•    Ensure data availability, quality, and reliability for AI and analytics use cases•    Work closely with data scientists to enable feature pipelines and machine learning workflows•    Develop and maintain scalable architectures supporting end-to-end AI products•    Contribute to building a modern data platform (Databricks, cloud, orchestration, monitoring) •    Support the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and transformation to serving data for AI and business insights•    Collaborate with stakeholders across business, IT, and product teams to translate needs into scalable solutions
 You will be part of building something new, defining ways of working, setting standards, and shaping how we scale AI across the Tools division. You will help define not only what we built, but how we build it.
  
 Your profileWe are looking for someone who combines strong technical skills with a pragmatic and collaborative mindset. You enjoy solving real problems, building robust systems, and working in a fast-evolving environment.
 We believe you bring:•    Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role (mid–senior level)•    Strong skills in Python and SQL for data processing and transformation •    Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Azure, Databricks) •    Experience building data pipelines and working with orchestration tools •    Understanding of modern data architectures and scalable data workflows•    Experience collaborating with data scientists and enabling ML pipelines
 As a person, you are:•    Curious and solution-oriented•    Collaborative and comfortable working cross-functionally•    Pragmatic, with a focus on delivering value•    Motivated by building something new and making real impact
  
 Location and otherThis position can be located in Fagersta, Stockholm, or Örebro, Sweden. We offer a hybrid way of working that supports flexibility and work-life balance. Occasional travel may be required.
  
 Why Epiroc?By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact. 
 You will be part of a journey where you:•    Build foundational capabilities for AI in an industrial context•    Work at the intersection of business, technology, and innovation•    Contribute to global solutions used across operations and markets•    Help scale AI from experimentation to production
  
 Application and contact informationWe encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-10-11. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.

You will work with engineers, analysts and domain specialists who look at the same information from different angles. The partner expects assumptions, datasets and evaluation methods to be visible. Create reusable training and inference infrastructure.


Automate model packaging, validation and deployment.


Build feature, registry and experiment tracking integrations.


Implement monitoring for data and model behaviour.


Manage compute, access and cost controls.


Support teams adopting the platform through examples and documentation.

What you will bring
Production platform, DevOps or machine learning engineering experience.


Strong Python and cloud infrastructure knowledge.


Containers, Kubernetes and CI CD.


Experience with ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow or managed cloud services.


Infrastructure as code and observability skills.


Ability to design for both researchers and operators.

Experience that would add value
GPU workload orchestration.


Feature stores and online inference.


Governance in healthcare, finance or public services.

A background that can succeed here
Your route may be from platform engineering into machine learning or from data science into production systems. We value people who understand both experimentation speed and operational control.

The partner offers a platform at the point where good foundations will have lasting influence. You will multiply the effectiveness of several ML teams and see your work reflected in faster, safer releases.

jobs.title: Simulation Platform & ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Turn cutting-edge simulation and ML research into software that engineers can actually use.
At GREEN14, we are building simulation technology for complex industrial processes. Our team combines multiphysics models, machine learning and experimental data to understand systems such as plasma reactors and high-temperature metallurgical processes.
We can build sophisticated models and fast surrogates. Now we want to turn that capability into robust software that can be used beyond our own research environment.
WHAT WE ARE BUILDING
GREEN14 started five years ago with a mission to develop emission-free production of critical raw materials using hydrogen plasma.
Today, we operate a full-scale plasma reactor in Stockholm. Alongside it, we have built capabilities in multiphysics simulation, AI and surrogate modelling.
Our ambition is to connect experiments, physics, simulation, surrogate models and optimization into a continuous learning process.
But a great model sitting in a research notebook is not a product. Models need data and pipelines. Experiments need to be reproducible. Software needs APIs. Models need to be tested and versioned. Computation needs to be fast and reliable.
That is where you come in.
YOUR ROLE
You will build the software and computational infrastructure connecting our physics, AI and experimental data.
You will work directly with scientists and engineers developing our models and turn research code into software other engineers can reliably use.
A typical problem might start with JAX code developed by a researcher. Your job is to ask:
How do we make this reliable, testable, reproducible, fast and usable by someone who did not write it?
You will have substantial ownership over the technical foundations of our simulation platform.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

Build backend architectures connecting sensor data, physics models, ML models and simulation workflows.


Turn JAX-based research code into maintainable, production-ready software.


Build pipelines connecting experimental data, simulation, surrogates and optimization.


Develop infrastructure for model training, evaluation and reproducibility.


Build APIs, packages and repositories for long-term production use.


Establish testing, CI/CD, versioning and monitoring for scientific software.


Identify computational bottlenecks and improve performance.


Contribute to deployment and cloud infrastructure as our products mature.


WHO YOU ARE
You have experience taking technically complex software from prototype to something other people can reliably use.
You might come from software engineering, ML engineering, scientific computing or data engineering.
We are particularly interested in experience with:

Python and modern software engineering.


JAX or other numerical and ML frameworks.


Backend architectures and APIs.


Data pipelines and databases.


ML infrastructure and MLOps.


Testing, CI/CD and reproducible workflows.


Computationally intensive workloads.


Experience with Docker, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, GPU computing, FastAPI or ML tooling is useful. Experience with JAX, scientific computing or simulation software is particularly relevant.
We do not expect you to tick every box.
THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR
You do not need to be a plasma physicist.
What matters is that you enjoy working at the boundary between scientific computing, machine learning and real-world software engineering.
You like understanding what researchers are trying to achieve, but your instinct is to turn clever prototypes into systems other people can depend on.
You care about architecture, performance and maintainability, but you also write code.
You should also be curious about the physical world behind the software. Our code represents real plasma, particles, materials and experiments.
WHY GREEN14
Many software engineers working in simulation never see the physical system their code represents.
Here, the reactor is downstairs.
Our engineers run experiments. Sensors generate data. Our simulation team compares results with models. The models improve. You build the infrastructure that makes that loop faster and more reliable.
Our ambition is broader than one reactor. We want to help engineers understand, optimize and scale complex high-temperature processes across industries.
HOW WE WORK
You will join a team of serious engineers and scientists who care about getting things right.
We are international, curious and direct. We challenge each other's thinking and change our minds when the data tells us to.
There is very little hierarchy. Good ideas matter more than titles.
We are ambitious, but low on ego. We work hard, flexibly, and value having a life outside work.
THE PRACTICAL STUFF
Compensation consists of salary and pension together with qualified employee stock options.
We are based at Sweden's leading technical university, close to central Stockholm and our plasma reactor.
If you want to turn physics, AI and experimental data into software that could change how industrial processes are developed and optimized, we would like to hear from you.
The position will remain open until we find the right person.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
SAVR is a fast-growing Swedish fintech company on a mission to reinvent investing. We empower investors with a platform that offers lower fees, greater transparency, and a radically improved experience.
We’re not just building another investment service — we’re reimagining how financial products should work for people, not just institutions. As part of our ambitious, innovative and curious team, you’ll help shape the future of investing in Sweden and beyond.
A quick note: This is not a traditional hiring process. While we're not actively looking to fill an immediate vacancy, we're always interested in meeting exceptional people who can help shape SAVR's future. If there's a strong mutual fit, we're open to exploring opportunities together
The Role – AI Engineer
As an AI Engineer with backend skills in our cross-functional team, you’ll join our tech team in Stockholm or Halmstad to build AI-powered product experiences end-to-end. You’ll work closely with fellow Software Engineers, Product Designers, and Product Managers to ship LLM-driven features such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, intelligent assistants, and automation, built for reliability, security, and great UX.
Our Tech Team Lead will manage and support your work, while reporting directly to our VP of Engineering. A glimpse into our tech stack: Python, SQL, Terraform, hosted on AWS, plus an AI stack that includes LLM APIs/open-source models, vector databases/similarity search, retrieval pipelines, evaluation tooling, and observability for production AI.
Your Mission
Build and ship LLM-powered product features (RAG, assistants, semantic search).


Productionize AI systems with guardrails, monitoring, evals, and cost/latency control.


Partner with product/design/engineering to turn use cases into measurable outcomes.


Build and maintain key platform features, APIs, and services, prioritizing scalability, reliability, and top-tier performance.


Provide direction and strategic insight on data related topics.

Additionally you will
Drive ideas and develop concepts from a tech perspective.


Explore ideas iteratively and refine them into production-quality solutions.


Contribute to improving the architecture, tech stack, and operational methods.


Improve our AI development workflow to support safe and reliable production AI.


Follow and promote good engineering practices to deliver high-quality products.


Engage in code reviews and foster a culture of continuous learning through constructive feedback.


Be a positive force for our team culture.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You...
4+ years of professional team-based software development experience, with at least some experience building ML/AI-powered features or systems in production.


Experience working with scalable, product-based environments, where you’ve shipped user-facing features and care about latency, reliability, and real-world constraints.


Solid understanding of backend systems and data modeling, enough to build reliable text retrieval, integrate with existing services, and reason about data quality, privacy, and access control in AI workflows.


Passion for applied AI, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, LLM evaluation, fine-tuning, and model serving.


Strong collaboration skills and an open-minded approach to exchanging ideas.


Fluent in English and a team player who values diverse perspectives.


Swedish citizen or valid EU work permits (we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role).


We’re seeking a motivated engineer with a broad skill set and a passion for applied AI, especially LLM-powered products, retrieval, and production-grade AI systems. You are someone who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and is eager to contribute to building something great.
Our Cultural DNA
At SAVR, we’re:

🧠 Open-minded – we embrace new ideas, diverse perspectives, and continuous learning
🚀 Bold – we take smart risks, move fast, and aren’t afraid to fail forward
🤝 Honest – we value transparency, feedback, and doing the right thing 
We’re a startup, so things can be a little messy — and that’s part of the thrill. If you thrive in building as a team and handling uncertainty, you will fit right in. 
What’s In It for You
You’ll join a product- and design-driven company where your work has real impact. We keep things lean, move fast, and genuinely care about the experience we deliver — for customers and for each other.
Here’s what we offer:
💻 Top-tier work gear
💰 Competitive salary
🏃‍♀️ Generous wellness allowance
🤒 Insurance package
🌱 Occupational pension and long-term savings support
🏢 Office-first approach to foster collaboration and quick decision-making — with flexibility when you need it (4+1)
🥗 Stocked pantry, plus regular social gatherings and wellness activities to keep energy and culture high

Our Commitment to Diversity
SAVR is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. We believe diverse teams build better products and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.
Ready to Join Us?
We’d love to hear from you. Apply now or reach out with any questions — and let’s build something meaningful together.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
SCRL is a mobile-first design platform built for social media and used by millions of creators worldwide.
We're a team based in central Stockholm, working closely across functions with a shared commitment to quality, clarity, and craft.


The role
This is a role with real impact and plenty of room to grow. You'll join the data team and work on the infrastructure that powers SCRL's analytics, forecasting, and AI-driven product features — from event ingestion all the way to the data services our apps rely on.
We're open to a range of experience levels. If you're earlier in your career, you'll learn alongside experienced data and engineering teammates and grow into broader ownership of the systems you build. If you come in with more experience, you'll have the opportunity to shape the direction of our data infrastructure and raise the bar for what we build next.
Either way, you'll work on real systems with real users — and you'll have the freedom to do the best work of your career.


What you will do
Data pipelines & infrastructure
Contribute to our ETL across the stack, helping make it easier to use, more reliable, and clearer when something goes wrong.
Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from the services we rely on (RevenueCat, Firebase Analytics, attribution providers, ad networks, and others) via API and event streaming.
Work in our BigQuery warehouse — schema design, Terraform-managed infrastructure, partitioning, and query optimization for a dataset that serves millions of users.
Develop and maintain GCP Cloud Functions and Cloud Run services for event processing, transformations, and scheduled jobs.
Help evolve our internal Python framework for shared models, utilities, and pipeline components used across the data codebase.

Analytics & modeling support
Bring data scientists' and analysts' models into production so they can be consumed reliably by the apps, backend services, and internal tools.
Build and maintain the data services that power product features such as template recommendations and personalization.
Support subscription analytics infrastructure: cohorting, LTV, ROAS, retention, and forecasting pipelines across iOS and Android.
Develop internal libraries and shared SQL/Python primitives for app metrics calculation, used by the broader team.

Data quality, observability & craft
Help implement monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks so we catch issues before stakeholders do.
Contribute to lineage and documentation that makes the warehouse navigable for everyone who uses it.
Support GDPR-compliant data handling, including consent propagation, retention policies, and deletion across systems.
Help maintain consistency of event schemas and metric definitions across web and mobile platforms.
Be a contributor to — and over time a champion of — data culture across the company.

You should have
Technical foundations
Languages: Solid proficiency in Python and SQL. Comfort with TypeScript/NodeJS or similar for service work is a plus, not a requirement.
Warehousing: Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses, ideally BigQuery — or strong fundamentals you're ready to transfer.
Pipelines: Some experience building or contributing to production data pipelines, from ingestion through transformation to serving.
Cloud infrastructure: Exposure to GCP (or AWS/Azure) is a strong plus. Familiarity with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform) is welcome but can be learned on the job.

Mindset & approach
Curiosity and care for craft: You take pride in the quality of what you ship and want to keep getting better at it.
Data pipelines owner mindset: You're interested in fully managing data flows from ingestion to processing, even if you haven't done it end-to-end yet.
Quality and pragmatism: You can work at a healthy pace without compromising the things that matter — clarity, reliability, and correctness.
Can-do attitude: Self-motivated problem solver with an eye for detail and an internal drive for excellence.

Product & business understanding
Subscription apps: Experience with or strong interest in subscription-based app businesses and freemium models.
Cross-platform thinking: Interest in the complexities of unifying data across web, iOS, and Android.
Analytics-driven approach: Comfortable working closely with analysts and data scientists, and wanting the data layer you build to support the insights the business needs.

Collaboration & communication
Team player: You work closely and generously with analysts, data scientists, backend, and mobile engineers.
Clear communication: You can explain what you're working on in a way that makes sense to teammates who don't share your technical background.

We offer
High-impact role: You'll work on the data platform that powers analytics, forecasting, and AI features for millions of users.
Room to grow: Take ownership of systems from early on, with support from experienced teammates and the space to develop into broader scope over time.
Startup environment: Fast-paced decision making with direct impact on product direction.
Strong team: Work alongside experienced data and engineering professionals in central Stockholm.
Competitive package: Market-rate salary with opportunities for professional development.
Creative culture: Be part of a profitable company that values creativity and user experience.

jobs.title: Simulation Product Engineer
jobs.description:
Turn complex physics and AI into products engineers actually use. Bridge simulation, software and industrial processes to change how engineers understand and optimize production.
At GREEN14, we are building a new generation of simulation technology for complex industrial processes.
Our team combines multiphysics models, machine learning and experimental process data to understand systems such as plasma reactors and high-temperature metallurgical processes.
We can build sophisticated models and fast surrogates. But for that technology to matter outside a research environment, a process engineer needs to be able to use it.
That is where you come in.
WHAT WE ARE BUILDING
GREEN14 started five years ago with a mission to help Europe develop emission-free production of critical raw materials using hydrogen plasma.
Today, we operate a full-scale plasma reactor in Stockholm. Alongside it, we have built capabilities in multiphysics simulation, AI and surrogate modelling.
Our ambition is to connect experiments, physics, simulation, surrogate models and optimization into a continuous learning process, and make that capability accessible to the engineer actually running the process.
Imagine an engineer trying to understand why yield has changed, how temperature is distributed inside a reactor, what happens if gas flow increases, or which operating parameters could produce a desired output.
They should not need to understand our solver architecture or write Python. They should be able to explore the process.
That is the product we want you to help us build.
YOUR ROLE
You will sit between simulation, software, product and industrial process engineering.
You will own much of how engineers interact with our technology: how they change process parameters, run scenarios, inspect simulation results, compare operating conditions and use models to make better decisions.
That requires more than frontend engineering.
You need to understand what the simulation represents, what matters to the engineer using it and how complex physical behaviour can be presented in an intuitive way.
You will work directly with our simulation and AI researchers, process engineers and industrial partners. Your job is to connect those worlds.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

Build interactive software for simulation, visualization and industrial process analysis.


Turn complex simulation outputs into intuitive visualizations.


Build interfaces for manipulating parameters, running scenarios and comparing results.


Define workflows from process problem and inputs to simulation, exploration and decision-making.


Connect applications to simulation and ML backends through APIs.


Build reusable components and application architecture for different simulation products.


Work with our simulation team to understand the underlying physics and how it should be exposed to users.


Help turn internal research tools into software industrial engineers want to use.


WHO YOU ARE
You are a strong software engineer who cares about both technical quality and whether the software actually solves a problem.
We are particularly interested in experience with:

React, TypeScript or a comparable modern stack.


Interactive and data-heavy applications.


Scientific, engineering or time-series visualization.


APIs and computational backends.


Application architecture and production software development.


Experience with Python, FastAPI, WebGL, Three.js, scientific visualization, Docker or cloud infrastructure is useful. Experience building software for engineering, scientific or industrial users is particularly valuable.
But technology is only part of the role.
THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR
You do not need to be a plasma physicist, but you do need to want to understand the process.
If an engineer tells you that pressure drop suddenly increases after twenty minutes, your first instinct should not only be to ask how we visualize the data. You should want to understand why.
What changed? What does the model say? Which variables matter? What can the operator control?
You enjoy talking to scientists and process engineers and asking questions until you understand the real problem.
Then you ask:
How do we turn everything we know into something this engineer can actually use?
That is the mindset we are looking for.
WHY GREEN14
Many software engineers building scientific products are several steps removed from the physical system their software represents.
Here, the reactor is downstairs.
You can talk to the person operating it, look at the experimental data, speak to the scientist modelling it and then build the software connecting those pieces.
Our current work is focused on plasma and high-temperature metallurgy, but our ambition is broader. We want to help engineers understand, optimize and scale complex industrial processes.
HOW WE WORK
You will join a team of serious engineers and scientists who care deeply about getting things right.
We are international, curious and direct. We challenge each other's thinking, share what we know and change our minds when the data tells us to.
There is very little hierarchy and no room for corporate politics. Good ideas matter more than titles.
We are ambitious, but low on ego. We help each other get better because the problems we are solving are genuinely hard.
We work hard, but flexibly, and value having a life outside work.
THE PRACTICAL STUFF
Compensation consists of salary and pension together with qualified employee stock options.
We are based at Sweden's leading technical university, close to central Stockholm. We want the people building our products close to the reactor, experiments and engineers using them.
If you want to turn sophisticated physics and AI into software that helps engineers make better decisions about real industrial processes, we would like to hear from you.
The position will remain open until we find the right person.

* Bridge the Gap: Act as a translator and facilitate discourse between high\-level stakeholders (leadership, ethics, and policy) and highly technical engineering/data science teams.

* Work Independently: Own your projects from conception to completion, while knowing when to collaborate with the broader team for support.


**Who you are**
---------------


* An Advanced Humanist: You hold a background in Sociology, Anthropology, Psychology, or Cognitive Science/HCI (Human\-Computer Interaction).

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

Acting as a thought partner to law firm partners, associates, and innovation teams - building trusted relationships, addressing tricky pain points, and identifying high-value opportunities for them to scale their use of Legora across practice groups.

Documenting best practices from leading firms, contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, and help shape how we grow this function globally.
Confidently helping law firms navigate one of the biggest shifts in how legal services are delivered - from evaluating the ROI and competitive advantage of AI to clearly mapping how AI will impact different practice areas, from corporate to disputes.

What you bring
You come from the world of Big Law; but you've never been content with how things have always been done. You may have trained and practised at a top-tier law firm, experiencing first-hand the pressures of billable hours, client demands, and operational inefficiencies. Maybe you've even left private practice to disrupt the status quo through a legal tech company, or ventures of your own. Have a background in law, with experience at a top-tier law firm - ideally across multiple practice areas or with exposure to firm-wide initiatives.

jobs.description:
Plant Engineering · Stockholm
Blykalla is scaling quickly to industrialize our small modular reactor (SMR) concept. If you are passionate about nuclear technology and want to make a meaningful impact, join us.
What we do at Blykalla
Blykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company developing lead-cooled small modular reactors. Our compact reactor design combines high safety with a simple, cost-effective and scalable approach to delivering clean, reliable baseload energy that complements solar and wind power.
The role
As Reliability Engineer, you will own reliability, availability and maintainability (RAM) engineering for Blykalla’s SEALER-55 lead-cooled fast reactor (LFR). You will work across assigned plant areas, systems and work packages within Plant Engineering, delivering quantitative reliability analysis that supports the plant design and the probabilistic safety assessment (PSA).
You will establish and apply Blykalla’s RAM, FMEA and FMECA framework, ensuring reliability and availability targets are translated into design, redundancy, sparing, testing and maintenance requirements. You will assess how design and maintenance decisions affect plant availability and lifecycle performance, and support the project from design through procurement, construction and handover to commissioning and operations.
What you’ll do
RAM engineering and modelling
Establish and maintain RAM, FMEA and FMECA methods, templates, criticality criteria, data sources and analysis assumptions.
Define reliability design bases, RAM targets, modelling methodology and requirements for assigned areas.
Build and maintain reliability block diagrams, fault trees and availability models, including Markov or Monte-Carlo simulations.
Work in RiskSpectrum for fault-tree and PSA-aligned modelling, alongside relevant RAM tools such as ReliaSoft, Isograph, GRIF or Maros/Taro.
Flow reliability, availability and maintainability requirements into specifications, data sheets and supplier packages.

Analysis and technical input
Perform and review RAM studies, FMEA/FMECA, reliability-centred maintenance analyses, criticality ranking, spares and logistics modelling, and lost-production analyses.
Quantify the impact of redundancy, maintenance strategies, test intervals and sparing on availability and lifecycle performance.
Develop reliability data and failure-rate estimates using sources such as ISO 14224 and OREDA, including Weibull/life-data analysis and common-cause assumptions.
Provide component failure data, maintenance assumptions and common-cause inputs to the PSA and safety case.

Interfaces, suppliers and delivery
Coordinate with process, mechanical, rotating equipment, electrical, I&C, civil and structural, layout, safety and licensing, and operations and maintenance teams.
Identify and resolve issues related to single points of failure, common-cause vulnerabilities, testability, maintainability and maintenance access.
Set and review RAM requirements for RFQs and supplier packages, including reliability data, FMECA and reliability demonstration requirements.
Contribute to estimates, schedules, risk reviews, design reviews, RFIs, site queries and change requests, including assessment of availability impacts.

Capability building
Mentor engineers and improve reliability methods, templates, checklists and data libraries.
Help build a scalable reliability engineering capability that supports Blykalla’s plant-as-a-product mindset, modular design and DfMA approach.

Typical deliverables
Reliability design bases and RAM targets; reliability block diagrams, fault trees and availability models; RAM study reports; FMEA/FMECA and criticality registers; RCM analyses; reliability data libraries; PSA inputs; supplier review comments; interface registers; and change-control or handover inputs.
Who you are
You have:
At least 6 years of hands-on experience in reliability or RAM engineering, including nuclear experience and RAM/PSA-support analysis for nuclear plants or systems.
Experience leading reliability engineering across a major plant area, full project or several complex work packages.
Strong quantitative RAM modelling skills and practical experience with RiskSpectrum.
Knowledge of relevant reliability and dependability standards, including IEC 60300, IEC 61078, IEC 61025, IEC 61165, IEC 61649 and IEC 60812.
Familiarity with ISO 14224, OREDA, nuclear reliability data, and relevant IAEA, regulatory and PSA guidance such as US NRC/NUREG and Swedish SSM guidance.
The ability to work across technical disciplines, manage ambiguity and balance technical rigour with practical delivery.
A collaborative, transparent and solution-oriented approach, with an interest in coaching others and strengthening the discipline.

What we offer
You will join a diverse and highly motivated Plant Engineering team and report to the Manager of Plant Engineering. This is an opportunity to help shape the reliability approach for a first-of-a-kind reactor programme and contribute directly to the future of clean nuclear energy.
Location: Stockholm

Du har chansen att få arbeta på en modern arbetsplats med en härlig samhörighet bland alla anställda.*

**Rollen som Legal Assistant**


Du kommer att arbeta heltid som en del av vår assistentgrupp, i ett team med fem andra assistenter och bistå våra delägare och biträdande jurister med varierande arbetsuppgifter. **Som en del av assistentgruppens arbete kommer du även att arbeta med KYC och andra compliancekontroller.** Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar exempelvis:

* Kontakt med myndigheter och domstolar
* Korrekturläsning
* Intern och extern korrespondens via mail, telefon och brev
* Scanning, kopiering och arkivering
* Framtagning och justering av PowerPoint\-presentationer.


Du kommer också att vara en del av en pågående satsning på att integrera AI i syfte att optimera och förbättra arbetsprocesserna. Genom dessa arbetsuppgifter får du möjlighet att aktivt bidra till Cirios framgång och utveckling!

**Att arbeta på Cirio**


Cirio är en fullservicebyrå i Stockholm med 160 medarbetare och vi bistår såväl svenska som internationella klienter. Hos oss på Cirio står teamet i centrum. Vi är en innovativ och modern byrå, som på bästa sätt kan möta nya behov i en tid när det sker så stora genomgripande förändringar av samhället och näringslivet, som t.ex. Grön omställning, AI och digitalisering.

jobs.title: Dataanalytiker inom Signal/ATC spännande konsultuppdrag.
jobs.description:
Vi söker en erfaren Dataanalytiker inom Signal/ATC för ett kvalificerat konsultuppdrag.
  
Uppdraget är en del av ett arbete med att minska tågförseningar som orsakas av fel i tågskyddssystemets ATC\-utrustning. Du kommer att arbeta med analys av data från järnvägsfordon och Trafikverkets anläggning, identifiera avvikelser och ta fram beslutsunderlag för att förebygga och åtgärda fel.
  
Rollen kombinerar järnvägsteknik, dataanalys, datavisualisering och kravställning av IT\-system.
  
Arbetsuppgifter
  
  

**I rollen kommer du bland annat att:**  

samla in och analysera information om signalanläggningar och rapporterade ATC\-fel
  
bearbeta data för att identifiera felaktiga eller avvikande ATC\-baliser
  
ta fram underlag för entreprenörer inför planerade och akuta åtgärder
  
analysera fordonsrelaterade ATC\-händelser och identifiera återkommande avvikelser
  
återkoppla identifierade fel till berörda järnvägsoperatörer
  
delta i möten och samverkan med Trafikverket och järnvägsföretag
  
arbeta med visualisering av data i Power BI, Qlik Sense eller motsvarande verktyg
  
bidra till kravställning av nya och förändrade funktioner i IT\-stödet ATC\-analys
  
stödja Trafikverkets förvaltning och vidareutveckling av ATC\-analys
  
dokumentera analyser, resultat och krav enligt etablerade arbetssätt.
  
  

Uppdraget innebär att analyserna ska omsättas till konkreta underlag som kan användas för att förebygga störningar och effektivisera felavhjälpningen i järnvägsanläggningen.
  
Vi söker dig som har
  
För att vara aktuell för uppdraget behöver du uppfylla följande krav:
  
Yrkeshögskoleexamen eller motsvarande eftergymnasial utbildning med inriktning mot infrastruktur
  
minst 2 års yrkeserfarenhet inom Signal/ATC
  
minst 2 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av datavisualiseringsverktyg, exempelvis Power BI, Qlik Sense eller motsvarande
  
minst 2 års erfarenhet av programmering i DAX och Power Query/M, alternativt Qlik Expressions och Qlik Script/Load Script eller liknande
  
erfarenhet av att arbeta strukturerat med dataanalys, dokumentation och kvalitetssäkring
  
god analytisk förmåga och förmåga att omsätta teknisk data till tydliga besluts\- och åtgärdsunderlag.
  
  

Kompetenskraven ska kunna styrkas genom CV och relevanta referensuppdrag.
  
Det är meriterande om du har
  
erfarenhet av Trafikverkets verksamhet eller järnvägssektorn
  
erfarenhet av ATC\-analys eller liknande system
  
erfarenhet av järnvägens signalanläggningar och baliser
  
erfarenhet av Power BI/Qlik i större tekniska miljöer
  
erfarenhet av kravställning och vidareutveckling av IT\-system
  
erfarenhet av att arbeta med stora datamängder och identifiera mönster, avvikelser och fel.
  
  

Vi erbjuder
  
Du får möjlighet att arbeta i ett tekniskt och samhällsviktigt uppdrag där dataanalys används för att bidra till ökad punktlighet och minskade störningar i den svenska järnvägstrafiken.
  
Du kommer att samarbeta med Trafikverkets ATC\-team, järnvägsföretag och andra aktörer inom järnvägssektorn.
  
Uppdraget innebär även möjlighet att arbeta med en kombination av teknisk analys, datavisualisering, järnvägsteknik och systemutveckling/kravställning.
  
Ansökan
  
Är du intresserad av uppdraget och uppfyller kompetenskraven? Skicka gärna ditt CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet inom Signal/ATC, dataanalys och Power BI/Qlik till \> Urval sker löpande.
  
Välkommen med din ansökan!
